attBesluta.text: A simple solution for my front steps. It added a degree of stability and confidence for my wife to safely navigate the front stairs. Easy to install, as the right size masonry bit required and fasteners were provided. It worked extremely well for my front step needs.
Super leuning en nog mooi ook. Gemakkelijk geplaatst, waardoor mijn echtgenote weer veilig op en af kan gaan.

We bought one of these a few weeks ago for our outdoor entryway (2 steps up). We like it so much, we decided to have another mounted to the other side of the entryway steps. It is solidly built and powder coated with a somewhat textured finish for a solid, non-slip, handhold. We'll see how well it holds up to daily use. All hardware (nuts, bolts, screws for mounting into both wood and concrete) included...it even includes a carbide tip drill and expansion bolts for concrete mounting. Recommend!
très bien comme article et facile à installer...je recommande
Leider fängt das Geländer schon an zu Rosten. Aber das ist auch wirklich das einzige was man bemängeln kann. Sehr stabiles Geländer.

I really love how the railing looks. I did have to replace the hex screws that came with it, as two sheared off when i was ratcheting them in. Now the railing is really sturdy, looks amazing, and only took 1/2 hour to install!

Fazit, ich würde sie wieder kaufen und auch meinen Freunden empfehlen.
